checks.method: Traced SupportReduction through inherited exists_intersecting_fin_relabel, map_restrictSet, cardinality preservation, and sunflower reflection.
checks.observation: A counterexample with more than 27 members supplies an exact 28-member subfamily; hereditary predicates are explicitly transferred before applying support53. Restricting to its union has a recovery map, preventing member collapse. The support equivalence followed by Fin.castLEEmb injects into Fin53 even when fewer than 53 points are used; surjectivity is unnecessary. Embedding lemmas preserve member/family sizes and reflect distinct-petal sunflowers. The named I(27) is Type-level, while counterexample reduction accepts Type u. Neither the equivalence nor padding supplies finite nonexistence, whole-family support control for larger counterexamples, or an extremal improvement, and the manuscript does not claim these.
checks.scope: Selection, injective relabeling, and universe transfer

content.summary: The attempted member-collapse and insufficient-capacity attacks on finite reduction fail against the actual source. The equivalence retains exactly the required hypotheses and does not establish exclusion. Both frozen hashes match.
